topic: Agent Foundations (LLM agents — ReAct / Plan-and-Solve / Reflexion / Toolformer / Function Calling / MCP / A2A / Computer Use / Benchmarks / Production Patterns)
byline: Ruofeng Yang (杨若峰), Shanghai Jiao Tong University

issues: ReAct Table swapped ReAct→CoT-SC and CoT-SC→ReAct numbers; ReAct paper Table 1 gives different values for HotpotQA / Fever.
TL;DR §0 #2 and Q1 overstate ReAct vs CoT on HotpotQA; pure ReAct EM 27.4 is below CoT 29.4.
SWE-bench Verified ~58% problematic statement; OpenAI reports 38.3% underspecified + 61.1% test issues.
Q21 gave invented exact failure-mode percentages with no source.
Q25 claimed OSWorld human basically full score; actual 72.36%.
Table cell |h_t| math needed \lvert h_t \rvert escape.
Python code blocks had undefined helpers: search_engine/kb_lookup/run_python/build_prompt/embed/cosine; missing import time; await missing in async fn.
rounds.fix: Rewrote ReAct results table with ReAct→CoT-SC 35.1 and CoT-SC→ReAct 64.6 separated; added 'three key facts' callout. Corrected TL;DR §0 #2 and Q1 to clarify ReAct < CoT on HotpotQA but wins on ALFWorld/WebShop. Cited OpenAI 38.3% / 61.1% on SWE-bench Verified. Removed invented Q21 percentages; replaced with qualitative ordering with cited sources. Corrected OSWorld human 72.36% in §8.3 + Q25. Replaced |h_t| in table with \lvert h_t \rvert. Added stubs for search_engine/kb_lookup/run_python/embed/cosine; added build_prompt def; added import time; restructured parallel_tool_step as async with await.

issues: ReAct Fever ReAct→CoT-SC = 62.0 (not 61.0); ALFWorld ≈ 70.9/71 (not 70.7).
Caption falsely claimed all numbers from Table 1; ALFWorld/WebShop come from later tables.
Reflexion WebShop 28% → 40%+ wrong — paper Fig 6 reports Reflexion does NOT significantly outperform ReAct on WebShop.
Claim that Plan-and-Solve had HotpotQA limited gains was unsupported — paper does not evaluate HotpotQA.
Q25 said SWE-bench used '2023+ issue' as held-out cutoff — original Jimenez paper has no such strict cutoff.
rounds.fix: Updated ReAct results table to Fever ReAct→CoT-SC = 62.0, ALFWorld ~71. Caption now clarifies Table 1 covers HotpotQA/Fever only; ALFWorld/WebShop from later tables. Reflexion table updated to show WebShop 'not significantly outperformed' with note in commentary. Q3 + §3.3 callout rewritten: list Plan-and-Solve actual datasets (GSM8K/AQuA/SVAMP/MultiArith/AddSub/SingleEq + commonsense + symbolic), drop HotpotQA limited-gains claim. Q25 contamination-control example replaced with SWE-bench+ / SWE-rebench.

issues: Cost formula used $|a_t + \text{thought}_t|$ — ambiguous notation.
parallel_tool_step async but called llm.messages.create without await.
Q8 oversimplified MCP/A2A as 'both JSON-RPC 2.0 + HTTP'.
Reflexion §4.2 cited a multi-armed-bandit/UCB appendix that does not exist in the paper.
A2A AgentCard sample was missing v0.3 fields (protocolVersion, preferredTransport, securitySchemes/security).
A2A lifecycle was missing auth-required and unknown states; transport claim overstated as JSON-RPC over HTTP only.
rounds.fix: Cost formula notation rewritten with $|y_t|$ = LLM output tokens; latency similarly updated. Added explicit `await` on llm.messages.create in parallel_tool_step. Q8 now explicitly notes MCP uses stdio/HTTP, A2A v0.3 supports JSON-RPC/gRPC/HTTP+JSON via preferredTransport. Removed bandit/UCB claim; replaced with paper-grounded note on Reflexion task scope. AgentCard sample updated to v0.3 (protocolVersion 0.3.0, preferredTransport, additionalInterfaces, securitySchemes/security). Task lifecycle now includes auth-required + unknown.

issues: Notation conflict: o_t defined as observation in §1 but used as LLM output in §9 cost formula.
Reflexion code: react_loop signature mismatch — build_prompt output passed as question but react_loop would re-wrap.
Q8 stale at v0.3 — needs to mention v1.0 has been released as of 2026Q1.
MCP DCR stated as required; 2025-11-25 spec downgraded to MAY (added CIMD alternative).
Agent S3 + bBoN 72.6% date attribution wrong (was 2026Q2; actual 2025-12-16).
rounds.fix: Cost formula notation $y_t$ disambiguated from observation $o_t$ via explicit note in §9.1 and Q15. react_loop signature extended to accept `reflections=memory` arg; Reflexion code calls it correctly. Q8 + §6.2 intro mention A2A v1.0 (Part redesign, SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE enum, signed agent card). MCP DCR text changed to MAY + introduced CIMD. Agent S3 entry corrected to 2025-12-16.

issues: Toolformer utility filter formula was simplified; original paper uses L_i^- = min(no-call, call-no-result) - L_i^+ >= τ_f.
Latency decode used $|a_t|$ instead of newly defined $|y_t|$.
Reflexion code returned mixed types between success / failure paths.
Agent S3 + bBoN attribution conflated tiers — 72.6% is wider scaling, Agent S3 + bBoN alone reports 69.9%.
Q24 listed Anthropic Constitutional Classifiers under self-improvement; it's a jailbreak safety classifier, not self-improvement.
rounds.fix: Toolformer §5.2 + Q4 rewritten with min over (no-call) and (call-no-result), τ_f notation explicit. Latency uses $|y_t|$. Reflexion returns consistent (answer, history) tuple in both branches. OSWorld row + appendix expanded to 'Agent S3 单 agent 62.6% → + bBoN 69.9% → wider scaling 72.6%'. Q24 removed Constitutional Classifiers misattribution; added note explaining it's a jailbreak classifier not self-improvement.

issues: MCP lifecycle described `shutdown` message; 2025-11-25 spec has no shutdown message — transport closure terminates.
Anthropic Tool Use stated as 2024-03 onwards; actually beta 2024-04, GA 2024-05-30.
ReAct §2.1 intro still overgeneralized vs CoT/Act-only.
rounds.fix: §6.1.2 + Q7 lifecycle rewritten to end with 'transport closure'; explicitly noted spec defines no shutdown message. Tool-use generation table updated to 'beta 2024-04, GA 2024-05-30'. §2.1 intro now qualifies ReAct strong on interactive decision / Fever; weak vs CoT-SC on HotpotQA.

issues: Q22 said MCP sampling requires 'per-call user consent'; spec is SHOULD human-in-loop, not MUST per-call.
Agent S3 single agent percentage still imprecise.
Q13 protocol wording: 'MCP 协议层是 transport' was technically wrong (MCP is application protocol over transport).
rounds.fix: Q22 sampling consent rewritten as 'SHOULD human-in-the-loop', client controls allow/deny, no per-call MUST. OSWorld row + appendix updated with precise Agent S3 single 62.6% + bBoN 69.9% + wider scaling 72.6%. Q13 punchline reworded to clarify MCP is application-level JSON-RPC over stdio/HTTP transports.

issues: Q13 still called MCP-style content 'trusted text'; need to phrase as protocol does not enforce isolation/validation — host must treat as untrusted.
OSWorld 27% 'task ceiling' statement was unsupported; 72.36% human is baseline not ceiling.
rounds.fix: Q13 rewritten: 'MCP only specifies transport + RPC shape; content is not labeled trusted vs untrusted by protocol — host must treat as untrusted.' OSWorld row clarified 'human baseline 72.36% (OSWorld paper reported value, not task ceiling); 距离任务实际上限仍有空间.'

post_ship_review.scope: full-collection rescan + adversarial re-audit (Codex GPT-5.6-sol + independent Claude cross-check)
post_ship_review.fix: 2026-07-12 全集重扫复审: Codex GPT-5.6-sol 找候选错误 (15 条), 独立 Claude 对抗验证 (逐条尝试推翻) → 11 CONFIRMED + 3 NEEDS_NUANCE 已修复, 1 REFUTED 保留原文。修复摘要: (1) CoT “latent space” 措辞改为“自身 token 序列内推理”(TL;DR + Q1, 澄清 CoT 与 ReAct 的真实区别是有无外部 grounding 而非 latent-vs-explicit); (2) §1.1 POMDP 用词精确化, 区分隐藏 state s_t / 历史 h_t (充分统计量) / belief b_t (最小充分统计量), 并让 §1.3 state 行与之统一; (3) 区分 Plan-and-Solve (Wang 2023, 单次生成内纯 prompting, 不含工具调用) 与生产界 Plan-and-Execute 架构 (工具调用+replan 的后续工程模式), 避免误将后者内容归到 Wang 2023 论文 (TL;DR + §3.1); (4) Function Calling schema 合规性去绝对化: 普通 function calling 不保证 100% 合规, 100% 靠 2024-08 起 strict/Structured Outputs, 补充 OpenAI gpt-4-0613 35.4% 合规率数据 (§5.1 表格 + §5.3 + Q5); (5) §5.3 JSON 示例澄清为 Anthropic 专属字段名 (input_schema/tool_use/input), 并注明 OpenAI 对应字段是 parameters/tool_calls/function.arguments; (6) MCP 标准化的是应用层 (JSON-RPC message schema + capability negotiation) 而非 transport 层 (§5.1 末尾); (7) stdio 安全模型去误导化: 子进程继承宿主用户完整权限, 无额外 sandbox, 相对安全性只来自无公网暴露面而非 OS 强制隔离 (§6.1.4); (8) MCP prompt injection 段落澄清信任边界完全在 host 应用层, 协议本身不做 trusted/untrusted 标记, 与 Q13 已有的准确表述保持一致 (§6.1.4); (9) §7.3 working memory mitigation 修正 “prepend 到最后” 的自相矛盾, 改为 “prepend 到开头”; (10) §9.3 Pass@k 公式补充 i.i.d. 前提 (agent retry 常相关, 实际可靠性提升低于公式理论值), Q19 同步补充; (11) Q6 “AlfWorld 75 → 97” 修正为 “75/134 (约56%) → 130/134 (约97%)”, 避免原始计数与百分比混用; (12) Q18 “Verified 抽样确保两者都干净” 弱化为 “旨在筛除最明显问题”, 消除与同一答案后文 “~59% 仍含瑕疵” 的自相矛盾; (13) Q24 DeepSeek-R1 与 OpenAI o-series 的 rule-based reward 表述分离, R1 已证实、o-series 为社区推测未经证实; (14) Q25 “Human upper bound” 改为 “Human reference score”, 补充 §8.3 已有的 Simular 2025-12-16 OSWorld 72.6% 越过人类基线的事实, 避免暗示人类基线不可超越。REFUTED 未改动: L444 “HTTPS POST + SSE 双向流” 的措辞经核实是 POST(client→server)+SSE(server→client) 合并描述双向流, 而非声称 SSE 本身双向, 不算错误。EN 版 (agent_foundations_tutorial_en.md) 同步做了对应的自然英文修正。两版已重新渲染 HTML, sidecar hash 已刷新。
